messages:
rhea: Quick sync 1: we need a benchmark story for next Tue focus: latency vs $/1k tokens, simple CTA to estimate costs.

mike: I can do a minimal visual set: one static social PNG and an interactive chart for the demo page. Suggest scatter (latency vs $) + small p95/p99 CDF inset.

anya: Copy: social short, landing explainer, and webinar hook. Social draft: 'Latency vs dollars: see where your workload sits.' Landing: 'Understand the tradeoffs that drive your inference bill.' CTA: 'Estimate token cost' -> bench_demo tag.

joel: Routing: clicks -> three flows (self-serve, AE, security). Add utm_segment and internal bench_* tags. Track chart interactions as high intent.

mike: Deliverables: PNG 1200x628, Vega preview for demo, small GIF of cache on/off. ETA Monday noon.

rhea: Good. Sampler KPIs: demo CTR >= 6% and chart interaction rate > 12% first week. A/B test headline short vs explanatory on landing. Tag #assets when uploaded.
